tasks.test:browser: deno task build && deno test -A tests/browser
tasks.test: deno test --allow-read --allow-env tests/*_test.ts && deno task test:browser
tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check src/main.ts src/desktop.server.ts src/bundle.ts src/features/editor/editor.client.ts src/features/settings/settings.client.ts && deno task test
tasks.desktop: deno task build && deno desktop --icon=src/assets/static/desktop-icon.png --include dist --include _fresh src/desktop.server.ts --allow-env=HOME,XDG_DATA_HOME,LOCALAPPDATA,APPDATA,PORT,DENO_SERVE_ADDRESS --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run=zenity,kdialog,which,osascript,powershell .
tasks.desktop:dev: deno task build && deno desktop --hmr --icon=src/assets/static/desktop-icon.png --include dist --include _fresh --allow-env=HOME,XDG_DATA_HOME,LOCALAPPDATA,APPDATA,PORT,DENO_SERVE_ADDRESS --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run=zenity,kdialog,which,osascript,powershell src/desktop.server.ts
